summary: Completed visual redesign regression testing for Rokadly app. Tested all user roles (admin, manager, accountant, cashier) and verified dark jewel-tone theme implementation. Found and fixed one CSS specificity issue with print preview backgrounds. All functionality working correctly after visual redesign.

backend_issues.notes: Backend was not modified in this visual redesign. Previous test showed 34/34 passing. No backend testing performed as per instructions.

design_issues.issue: Print preview background was dark instead of light parchment due to CSS specificity - body's dark background was overriding .print-preview class
design_issues.fix_applied: Added !important to .print-preview background-color and background-image in App.css to ensure parchment background displays correctly

frontend_issues.notes: Visual redesign successfully implemented. Dark jewel-tone theme (sapphire/ruby/emerald + brass) applied throughout. No white backgrounds found in main app UI. Print preview pages intentionally use light parchment background (now fixed). All data-testid attributes preserved.
